scope: Stable textile teaching facts only; no current stock, prices, incident claims or verified product-test results. Refresh the reviewed bank when useful distinct lessons are exhausted. During a dated campaign the bank also holds Sale91 DTF service facts from its own live pages and Canva Help.
audience_evidence: Owned-audience audit 12-Sep-2026: 231 non-owner top-level public comments from a purposive MAIN/Instagram sample (not unique buyers or a survey), with overlapping fabric/GSM discussion39comments across12posts, fit29/11, wash17/8 and printing14/4. Requests include biowash/fabric-label meaning, why320GSMcan feel thin and boxy proportions. Own-site GSC13-Aug–9-Sep: query240 gsm t shirt2132impressions/33clicks, oversized variant694/13, acid wash t shirt451/1. These are this site's Google Search observations, not global volume or YouTube search data. Prioritize clearly explained buyer distinctions; paid/organic channel split remains unknown. Exact lesson wording is editorial synthesis, never an invented customer quote. Boxy, printing failure and acid-wash durability need actual source-specific measurements/test footage; they are not approved technical facts in this bank.

combing_short_fibres.claim: Combing is an additional fibre preparation step that removes short fibres before yarn spinning. Carding aligns and cleans fibres; combing and spinning are different stages.
combing_short_fibres.limits: Do not identify carded/combed or ring/open-end yarn by rubbing sound, feel alone or an AI close-up. No claim about a specific supplied T-shirt without its specification.

knit_loop_stretch.claim: Knitted fabric consists of intermeshing yarn loops. Movement of those loops supplies stretch and flexibility. A knitted structure can stretch without that observation establishing added elastane.
knit_loop_stretch.limits: The final sentence is the direct buyer inference from loop construction. Stretch alone does not establish fibre composition, recovery quality or preshrinking.

jersey_face_back.claim: In single jersey, the technical face shows the legs of loops as vertical V-like columns; the reverse shows the loop crowns more prominently in horizontal rows. Face and back therefore differ.
jersey_face_back.limits: Teach construction, not a pass/fail quality test. Technical face does not make the reverse universally the wrong design or printing side. This source establishes no guaranteed printing result; recommend identifying the intended side and testing the actual blank with its printing process. Do not label generated close-ups as a microscope view of actual stock.

pique_tuck_structure.claim: Tuck stitches create cellular texture in pique constructions used for polo shirts. In a tuck cycle, a needle retains the old loop and collects another yarn; later, new yarn is knitted through the held loop and tuck loop. Pique is a knit construction, rather than a fibre-composition label.
pique_tuck_structure.limits: The distinction between construction and fibre label is a buyer inference. Do not call tuck loops incomplete or partially pulled-through stitches. Do not assume identical texture, universal breathability or printing suitability. Printing performance depends on the actual fabric and process, not fibre alone.

french_terry_fleece.claim: In the described cotton constructions, French terry retains un-napped loops or floats on the inside. Brushing or napping the interior creates the fleecy surface of fleece.
french_terry_fleece.limits: Explain this construction/finishing distinction, not universal warmth, GSM or superiority. Do not infer exact fibre composition from appearance.

rib_width_stretch.claim: Basic rib alternates face and back wales. Under widthwise stretch its structure opens like an accordion; this extensibility suits neck, wrist and waistband trims.
rib_width_stretch.limits: Rib structure alone does not certify stretch recovery or wash durability. Do not prescribe universal collar measurements or promise it cannot become loose.

interlock_vs_jersey.claim: Interlock connects two rib structures and has a similar appearance on both sides. Single jersey has distinct face and reverse appearances; their structures differ.
interlock_vs_jersey.limits: Do not infer fibre, treatment, exact weight, price or print performance from the construction alone.

cotton_count_direction.claim: English cotton count, Ne, is an indirect yarn-numbering system: a higher Ne number describes finer yarn. Direct systems such as denier work in the opposite direction.
cotton_count_direction.source_title: CottonWorks: Yarn Ply, Counts and Treatments
cotton_count_direction.limits: Always name Ne or English cotton count. This is yarn size, not a fabric-GSM or finished-product quality ranking.

biopolish_surface.claim: Cellulase biopolishing removes protruding microfibrils from cellulose-based fabric surfaces, reducing fuzz and improving surface smoothness. This is a surface-finishing process.
biopolish_surface.limits: Do not infer that visible fuzz proves no biowash, or guarantee zero pilling, no shrinkage or a number of washes. No specific chemical product or treatment setting is recommended.

compaction_shrinkage.claim: Compaction compresses fabric structure to reduce later length shrinkage. Residual shrinkage concerns dimensional change and is assessed through defined laundering and measurement conditions.
compaction_shrinkage.source_title: Cotton Incorporated: Guide to Improved Shrinkage Performance of Cotton Fabrics
compaction_shrinkage.limits: Stretch-and-release does not certify preshrinking. No zero-shrink guarantee, fixed percentage or universal care instruction; follow the actual garment care specification.

fabric_mass_per_area.claim: Fabric mass per unit area measures the mass of a defined area of fabric. It is a different quantity from the total weight of a finished garment.
fabric_mass_per_area.source_title: ASTM D3776/D3776M-20(2025): public abstract for Fabric Mass Per Unit Area
fabric_mass_per_area.limits: Use the public definition only, not an invented home certification procedure. The garment-weight distinction is dimensional reasoning. Weight alone does not establish fibre identity, finishing or all quality attributes. Do not prescribe a universal GSM minimum.

stitch_construction_jobs.claim: A twin-needle 406 coverseam is commonly used to hem knitted garments. Three-thread 504 overedge can join fabric plies as well as finish edges; two-thread 503 serging is not suitable for a loaded joining seam.
stitch_construction_jobs.limits: Describe specified common constructions, not every T-shirt. Two visible rows alone cannot identify the stitch or certify quality; no universal strength claim. Tubular garments may lack side seams.

garment_skew_after_laundering.claim: Skewness or torque is the tendency of some fabrics and garments to twist after laundering. Skewing displaces side seams, sleeves, legs and other parts of a garment, giving an unsatisfactory appearance.
garment_skew_after_laundering.limits: Describes the defect, not its size in any product. No zero-twist promise, fixed percentage or claim that a specific supplied T-shirt will or will not skew. A new unwashed garment may not show it.

singles_twist_liveliness_skew.claim: Garment twist, also called torque, comes from releasing latent stresses that build up in manufacturing; they are released during wet processing and laundering. In single jersey, wale skew is caused in part by singles spun yarn trying to untwist after knitting (twist liveliness), which deforms the loops; Z-twist yarns lean the wales right and S-twist yarns left. Plying two Z-twist singles together in the S direction can remove the liveliness, and in the cited trials looser stitches skewed more than tighter ones. AATCC Test Method 179 measures skewness change and garment twist after automatic home laundering.
singles_twist_liveliness_skew.source_title: Cotton Incorporated webinar slides: Understanding & Overcoming Skewing
singles_twist_liveliness_skew.limits: Trial percentages belong to the cited greige test fabrics; never quote them as product specifications. Do not identify twist, ply or spinning system by look or feel, or claim what yarn or finish a specific product uses. Mill controls (tighter knitting, plied balanced yarn, alternating S/Z feeds, pre-skew, crosslinking resin) are manufacturing choices; the source gives no home remedy, so never claim that one exists or that none exists.

discharge_printing.claim: In discharge printing, fabric is first dyed to the desired ground colour, usually a dark shade, and then printed with a chemical that selectively destroys the dye, leaving a white design. Alternatively, a discharge agent is printed together with a dye that the agent does not affect, so that dye replaces the ground colour in the design. Ground colours must be chosen that can be selectively destroyed without extraordinary means and without damaging the fabric, and discharge printing has higher production costs than normal printing techniques.
discharge_printing.limits: Describes the method on dyed fabric. Do not claim a specific T-shirt colour or dye will discharge, name a home chemical, or call the print soft, durable or long-lasting; no price or rupee amount.

acid_wash_discharge.claim: Acid wash is one of the effects achieved by wet discharge garment washing. 'Acid-washed' is a misnomer because the process uses no acid; typically the discharging agent is sodium hypochlorite or potassium permanganate. An abrasion cycle before acid washing gives the fabric surface variation; without it the effect looks flat.
acid_wash_discharge.limits: The source's step-by-step procedure is written for jeans; do not claim which chemical, steps, durability, colour fastness or pattern a specific T-shirt has. Beside a rate listing, say only that the listing names an acid-wash finish; never say a price gap pays for, is caused by or covers abrasion, chemicals or any process step. No home method or chemical-handling advice.

pilling_causes.claim: Pills are small balls of entangled fibres attached to the surface of a fabric. Pilling is affected by many factors, including the type of fibre or blend, fibre dimensions, yarn and fabric construction, fabric finishing treatments and end use. Its causes are construction and mill processing, so control must begin in material specification and mill processing; once goods show a tendency to pill there is normally no solution for the pills. With no universal durability standards, customer and supplier need to agree satisfactory performance levels for each product and end use.
pilling_causes.limits: Do not rank fibres or blends for pilling, judge pilling resistance by touch, or connect fuzz with the presence or absence of a biowash. No guarantee of zero pilling or a number of washes.

mercerization_lustre.claim: Cotton is a low-lustre fibre because of its convolutions. Mercerization of yarn or fabric improves lustre by permanently swelling the fibre: treatment with a strong sodium hydroxide solution (the source cites 25%) swells cotton and changes its cellulose structure, and under tension the fibre or fabric attains a high degree of lustre. Mercerized cotton is significantly stronger than natural cotton fibre.
mercerization_lustre.limits: Do not identify mercerization by shine or touch, claim a specific product is mercerized, or give home chemical instructions. No claims about softness, pilling, colour fastness or price.

polyester_oleophilic.claim: Polyesters are oleophilic, having a strong affinity for oils, and therefore must be treated with a soil-release chemistry to prevent soiling and body-odour retention. All polyesters are inert, so they are not easily modified.
polyester_oleophilic.limits: General fibre property from a cotton industry body. Do not claim a specific polyester T-shirt has or lacks a soil-release finish, promise odour-free wear, or rank odour against cotton.

dtf_sheet_size.claim: Sale91's DTF sheet is 22.8 inches wide and 39 to 390 inches tall. The buyer uploads one ready-made PNG sheet, and it is printed as uploaded: never stretched or cropped. One sheet can carry many designs (a gang sheet).
dtf_sheet_size.source_title: Sale91 DTF order form: sheet size and Details & tips
dtf_sheet_size.limits: Sale91's own product rule. Other printers use other widths. Do not quote a price from this fact.

dtf_min_resolution.claim: Sale91's DTF order form accepts a sheet from 250 DPI: at least 5700 pixels across the 22.8-inch width; 300 DPI (6840 pixels) is best. Changing only the DPI number in an image's settings adds no pixels, so a small file stays blurry.
dtf_min_resolution.source_title: Sale91 DTF order form: Details & tips and the low-resolution message
dtf_min_resolution.limits: The pixel numbers are Sale91's own gate for its 22.8-inch sheet. Do not claim a print result was tested.

dtf_transparent_background.claim: In a DTF sheet, anything that is not transparent gets printed: a white or coloured background prints as a solid rectangle. Glows, shadows and soft fades can print patchy.
dtf_transparent_background.source_title: Sale91 DTF order form: Details & tips
dtf_transparent_background.limits: Teach file preparation only; no claim about any one film or ink brand.

dtf_canva_png_size.claim: Canva counts a design's size at 96 pixels per inch. Its PNG download Size slider goes from 0.5x to 3.125x (a Canva Pro option, like the transparent background), so a 22.8-inch-wide design downloaded at 3.125x is 6840 pixels wide: 300 DPI. Canva Free downloads PNG at 1x, about 96 DPI.
dtf_canva_png_size.source_title: Canva Help: Resize designs and size limits; Choose the right download file type
dtf_canva_png_size.limits: Canva's plans and menus can change; say it is Canva's current help. The 22.8-inch arithmetic is ours. Canva Free has no Size slider and no transparent PNG.

dtf_pieces_whole_sheet.claim: On Sale91's DTF order form, 'pieces' means how many times the whole uploaded sheet is printed, and the price is the sheet's real height times the pieces. Designs for many T-shirts belong together on one sheet, not one sheet per T-shirt.
dtf_pieces_whole_sheet.source_title: Sale91 DTF: About, contact and pricing
dtf_pieces_whole_sheet.limits: Do not quote a rupee amount from this fact.

dtf_press_settings.claim: Sale91's pressing guide for its DTF prints: thin T-shirts (cotton, polyester) 165 degrees C for 5 seconds; hoodies and sweatshirts 180 degrees C for 5 seconds; medium-firm pressure; let it cool, then peel the film slowly (cold peel); press again 5 seconds with a Teflon sheet or baking paper on top.
dtf_press_settings.limits: These are the settings for Sale91's prints. Other films and presses differ; the guide says to test on a spare garment first. No wash-life promise.

dtf_service_launch.claim: Sale91 (Own Knitted Blank Wears) now prints DTF heat-transfer sheets from the buyer's own PNG file: upload the sheet, choose pieces, pay and track the order online at dtf.bulkplaintshirt.com. Sheets are printed by its partner in Surat and sent by courier across India.
dtf_service_launch.source_title: Sale91 DTF: About, contact and pricing
dtf_service_launch.limits: No delivery-time or quality promise beyond the page. No price in the spoken script.

seed_lessons.topic: बिना लाइक्रा के भी टी-शर्ट खिंचती क्यों है?
seed_lessons.buyer_question: Does a stretchy T-shirt always contain Lycra?
seed_lessons.lesson: A knitted T-shirt is made from intermeshing yarn loops. Those loops can move and open, so structure itself supplies stretch; that observation cannot identify the fibre blend.
seed_lessons.buyer_decision: Treat fibre composition and the feel of stretch as separate specifications.

seed_lessons.topic: फ्रेंच टेरी और फ्लीस में अंदर की सतह क्यों अलग है?
seed_lessons.buyer_question: What is the inside-surface difference between French terry and fleece?
seed_lessons.lesson: The described French terry construction keeps its inner loops or floats unbrushed. Napping those inner yarns creates the fleecy surface, so the finish explains their different interior feel.
seed_lessons.buyer_decision: Choose the interior surface for the intended garment, instead of treating both names as the same cloth.

seed_lessons.topic: धागे में तीस या चालीस काउंट: बड़ा नंबर, पतला धागा?
seed_lessons.buyer_question: Why can a higher cotton yarn count mean a finer yarn?
seed_lessons.lesson: English cotton count is an indirect yarn-size system. A higher Ne value means finer yarn, whereas a direct system such as denier increases with yarn size.
seed_lessons.buyer_decision: Name the yarn-count system before comparing two numbers; do not substitute yarn count for finished fabric weight.

seed_lessons.topic: रिब वाला गला ज्यादा फैलता कैसे है?
seed_lessons.buyer_question: Why is rib used on necklines and cuffs?
seed_lessons.lesson: Rib alternates face and back rows of loops. When stretched across its width the structure opens like an accordion, creating extensibility useful for necklines and cuffs.
seed_lessons.buyer_decision: Understand the structural reason for choosing rib, without assuming it guarantees wash recovery.

seed_lessons.topic: बायोवॉश और प्री-श्रंक एक ही चीज़ हैं क्या?
seed_lessons.buyer_question: Do biowash and preshrinking describe the same treatment?
seed_lessons.lesson: Biopolishing acts on protruding surface fibres. Compaction acts on fabric structure to reduce later shrinkage. These address different properties rather than being two names for one treatment.
seed_lessons.buyer_decision: Compare surface finishing and shrinkage control separately when reading a fabric specification.

seed_lessons.topic: कॉम्ब्ड कॉटन में धागा बनने से पहले क्या बदलता है?
seed_lessons.buyer_question: What extra preparation does combed cotton describe?
seed_lessons.lesson: Carding aligns and cleans fibres. Combing is an additional preparation stage that removes short fibres before spinning, so the label describes a manufacturing process rather than a rubbing sound or a simple feel test.
seed_lessons.buyer_decision: Treat fibre preparation and yarn spinning as separate parts of the specification when comparing fabrics.

seed_lessons.topic: टी-शर्ट का कपड़ा अंदर और बाहर अलग क्यों दिखता है?
seed_lessons.buyer_question: Why does single-jersey T-shirt fabric look different on its two sides?
seed_lessons.lesson: Single jersey presents the loop legs as vertical V-like columns on its face. On the reverse, the loop crowns appear more prominently in horizontal rows; the contrast comes from construction rather than proving that one side is defective.
seed_lessons.buyer_decision: Compare corresponding fabric sides when judging appearance; do not mistake the normal reverse structure for a fault.
seed_lessons.published_as: सिंगल जर्सी टी-शर्ट का सीधा-उल्टा अलग क्यों दिखता है?

seed_lessons.topic: पोलो की जाली जैसी बनावट: कपास का नाम या बुनाई का?
seed_lessons.buyer_question: Does the textured pique surface on a polo tell us its fibre composition?
seed_lessons.lesson: Tuck stitches create the cellular surface associated with pique knit constructions. Pique describes how the fabric is knitted, so its textured surface does not by itself establish which fibre was used.
seed_lessons.buyer_decision: Treat pique construction and cotton or other fibre composition as separate details when comparing polos.
seed_lessons.published_as: पोलो की जालीदार बुनावट कैसे बनती है — पीके (Pique) fabric का असली मतलब

seed_lessons.topic: टी-शर्ट का वजन और GSM एक नंबर क्यों नहीं हैं?
seed_lessons.buyer_question: Is a finished T-shirt weighing a certain number of grams the same as that GSM?
seed_lessons.lesson: Fabric mass per unit area relates fabric mass to a defined area. The total mass of a completed garment is a different measurement, so weighing the complete T-shirt does not directly give its fabric GSM.
seed_lessons.buyer_decision: Compare fabric GSM with fabric GSM and garment weight with garment weight; do not substitute one number for the other.
seed_lessons.published_as: GSM का मतलब कपड़े का वज़न है, पूरी टी-शर्ट का नहीं — ₹186 vs ₹205 Oversize में फ़र्क़ समझो

seed_lessons.topic: टी-शर्ट के नीचे और जोड़ पर अलग सिलाई क्यों होती है?
seed_lessons.buyer_question: Why can a T-shirt hem and a fabric joining seam use different stitch constructions?
seed_lessons.lesson: A 406 twin-needle coverseam is commonly used for hems in knitted garments. A 504 three-thread overedge can join fabric layers and finish their edges; these stitch constructions serve different jobs rather than acting as a universal quality ranking.
seed_lessons.buyer_decision: Judge the stitch against its job at that seam; two visible rows alone do not certify the whole garment.

seed_lessons.topic: धुलाई के बाद टी-शर्ट की साइड सिलाई आगे क्यों घूम जाती है?
seed_lessons.buyer_question: Why does a T-shirt's side seam twist towards the front after washing?
seed_lessons.lesson: Skew or torque is the tendency of some knitted garments to twist after laundering, displacing side seams and sleeves. In single jersey, singles spun yarn tries to untwist after knitting; this twist liveliness deforms the loops so the wales lean, and stresses built up in manufacturing are released in wet processing and washing.
seed_lessons.buyer_decision: Judge side-seam twist on a washed sample rather than a new piece, because the stresses behind it are released in laundering; for stripes and large prints, ask how the mill controls skew.

seed_lessons.topic: डार्क टी-शर्ट पर डिस्चार्ज प्रिंट: रंग ऊपर लगता है या कपड़े से हटता है?
seed_lessons.buyer_question: Is a discharge print an ink layer sitting on top of a dark fabric?
seed_lessons.lesson: Discharge printing starts from fabric already dyed to a ground colour, usually dark, and prints a chemical that selectively destroys that dye, leaving a white design. Printing the discharge agent with a dye it cannot affect puts a new colour in place of the ground. Not every ground colour can be destroyed without extraordinary means or fabric damage.
seed_lessons.buyer_decision: Choose discharge only after the printer confirms your ground colour can be discharged, instead of assuming any dark shade will lift cleanly.

seed_lessons.topic: एसिड वॉश टी-शर्ट में एसिड होता है क्या?
seed_lessons.buyer_question: Does an acid-wash finish actually use acid?
seed_lessons.lesson: Acid wash is one of the effects made by wet discharge washing, and the name is a misnomer: the process uses no acid. The discharging agent is typically sodium hypochlorite or potassium permanganate, which removes colour after dyeing; an abrasion step beforehand gives surface variation, otherwise the effect looks flat.
seed_lessons.buyer_decision: Treat acid wash as a colour-removal finish added to a base fabric, and compare the base fabric specification separately from the wash effect.

seed_lessons.topic: टी-शर्ट पर छोटी-छोटी गोलियाँ (पिलिंग) क्यों बनती हैं?
seed_lessons.buyer_question: What are the small balls on a worn T-shirt, and can a later wash remove them?
seed_lessons.lesson: Pills are small balls of entangled fibres attached to the fabric surface. How readily a fabric pills depends on its fibre or blend, fibre dimensions, yarn and fabric construction, finishing treatments and end use; these causes come from construction and mill processing, and once goods show a pilling tendency there is normally no fix.
seed_lessons.buyer_decision: Agree a pilling-performance level with the supplier at the material-specification stage, because a finished batch that pills normally cannot be corrected.

seed_lessons.topic: मर्सराइज़्ड कॉटन में चमक कहाँ से आती है?
seed_lessons.buyer_question: Is mercerized cotton a different kind of cotton?
seed_lessons.lesson: Mercerization treats cotton yarn or fabric with a strong sodium hydroxide solution that permanently swells the fibre and changes its cellulose structure. Natural cotton is low in lustre because of its convolutions; held under tension during the treatment it attains a high lustre, and mercerized cotton is significantly stronger than natural cotton fibre.
seed_lessons.buyer_decision: Specify mercerization as a separate processing step, not as a cotton variety or a substitute for combing or GSM.

seed_lessons.topic: पॉलिएस्टर टी-शर्ट में तेल के दाग और पसीने की बदबू क्यों टिकती है?
seed_lessons.buyer_question: Why can polyester T-shirts hold oily stains and body odour?
seed_lessons.lesson: Polyester fibres are oleophilic, meaning they have a strong affinity for oils. Because of that, polyester must be treated with a soil-release chemistry to prevent soiling and body-odour retention; polyesters are inert, so the fibre itself is not easily modified.
seed_lessons.buyer_decision: For polyester or sublimation T-shirts meant for sport or daily wear, ask whether a soil-release finish was applied rather than assuming the fibre resists oily soil.

seed_lessons.topic: Canva से DTF के लिए 300 DPI फाइल कैसे निकालें?
seed_lessons.buyer_question: My Canva PNG is rejected as low resolution for a DTF sheet. How do I get 300 DPI out of Canva?
seed_lessons.lesson: Canva counts a design at 96 pixels per inch, so a 22.8-inch design downloads only about 2189 pixels wide at 1x. The Pro Size slider at 3.125x multiplies those pixels to 6840 across the sheet, which is 300 DPI at the full width.
seed_lessons.buyer_decision: Make the design 22.8 inches wide in Canva and download PNG at Size 3.125x with a transparent background; Canva Free cannot do this.

seed_lessons.topic: DPI नंबर बदलने से DTF प्रिंट साफ़ क्यों नहीं होता?
seed_lessons.buyer_question: I changed my image from 72 DPI to 300 DPI. Why is the DTF sheet still refused as low resolution?
seed_lessons.lesson: Print sharpness comes from how many pixels cover the real sheet width, not from the DPI label stored in the file. A 22.8-inch sheet needs at least 5700 pixels across; relabelling a small image adds no new pixels, so it stays blurry.
seed_lessons.buyer_decision: Check the pixel width of the PNG before ordering: 5700 or more for a 22.8-inch DTF sheet, 6840 for the best result.

seed_lessons.topic: DTF शीट का बैकग्राउंड transparent क्यों होना चाहिए?
seed_lessons.buyer_question: Why did a white box print around my design on the DTF transfer?
seed_lessons.lesson: A DTF sheet prints every pixel that is not transparent, so a white or coloured background becomes a solid rectangle of ink on the shirt. Soft glows and shadows are partly transparent and can print patchy at their edges.
seed_lessons.buyer_decision: Export the sheet as PNG with a transparent background and remove glows or soft shadows before ordering.

seed_lessons.topic: Gang sheet क्या होती है? एक DTF शीट पर कई डिज़ाइन
seed_lessons.buyer_question: Do I need a separate DTF sheet for every design or T-shirt?
seed_lessons.lesson: A DTF gang sheet is one 22.8-inch-wide PNG that carries many designs side by side. The sheet is printed as uploaded, so the designs for many T-shirts share one sheet and the buyer pays for the sheet height, not per design.
seed_lessons.buyer_decision: Place all the designs for an order together on one sheet and leave small gaps for cutting.

seed_lessons.topic: DTF ऑर्डर में "pieces" का मतलब T-shirts नहीं है
seed_lessons.buyer_question: I have 28 designs on my sheet. Should I set pieces to 28?
seed_lessons.lesson: On Sale91's DTF form, pieces means how many times the whole uploaded sheet is printed. A sheet that already holds 28 designs needs one piece; setting 28 would print the entire sheet 28 times and multiply the cost.
seed_lessons.buyer_decision: Set pieces to the number of complete sheets you need, not the number of T-shirts or designs on them.

seed_lessons.topic: DTF प्रिंट कैसे प्रेस करें: 165 या 180 डिग्री?
seed_lessons.buyer_question: At what temperature and time should I press a DTF print on a T-shirt and on a hoodie?
seed_lessons.lesson: Sale91's guide uses 165 degrees C for 5 seconds on thin T-shirts and 180 degrees C for 5 seconds on hoodies and sweatshirts, with medium-firm pressure. The film is peeled only after cooling, then pressed again 5 seconds under a Teflon sheet or baking paper.
seed_lessons.buyer_decision: Use the garment-specific temperature, cold-peel, finish with a second covered press, and test one spare garment first.
